how: Each harness driven in a PTY by the end-to-end deck against the fake model, keys written as the person would, each state read once the screen settled. Each run is a sequence of screens in order, as a reader of `agents.slice` meets them; labels are the keys that led to a state. Paths, ids and an OAuth state are masked.
